conceptBlocks.text: 订单净销售属于业务收入指标，成功收款扣实际退款是资金事件净额；二者按订单及一致截止口径核对。差额为净现金减净销售。

syntax.purpose: 统计期间 2025年；截止日 2025-12-31；金额 马币分；输出粒度 订单。

problem: 财务需要核对2025年已完成订单的净销售与截至2025年12月31日成功收款扣实际退款后的现金净额。每个订单一行，只列差额非零的订单。

methodBlocks.text: 先在付款表按状态及截止日期筛选成功收款，再按订单汇总；同一订单可能拆分支付，失败重试不计。退款表通过订单明细定位订单，按退款发生日期筛选并汇总。
两个汇总表各自最多每订单一行，才与订单净额视图左连接；否则两笔付款与两笔退款相乘为四行。缺失资金事件在本题完整记录假设下补零。净现金=付款−退款，差额=净现金−净销售。
最后筛选订单日期和非零差额，按差额从大到小排序。截止日期只设上限，允许跨期预收；净销售视图的退款截止口径需核实，不能默认为与现金事件相同。

breakdown.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 3;

breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

breakdown.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 按订单汇集退款金额（b）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

completeCode.mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0) cash_net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)-o.net_cents difference_cents FROM v_order_net o LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)<>o.net_cents ORDER BY difference_cents DESC
completeCode.sqliteSql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0) cash_net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)-o.net_cents difference_cents FROM v_order_net o LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)<>o.net_cents ORDER BY difference_cents DESC

resultBlocks.text: 示例订单1成功收款1000分，实际退款200分，净现金800分，与净销售一致；订单2少收50分；订单3现金比净销售多100分，可能涉及跨期退款；
订单4截止日没有成功收款，差额−300分；订单5两端为零，不输出。正负差额只是核对线索，并非直接认定会计错误。
原企业结果引用显示零行，说明该基准库在既定查询口径下无差额，不代表所有资金流水均已核查，也不代表查询未执行。

comparison.text: 净销售不等于现金流，也不等于会计确认收入；时点、手续费、预收及退款状态须按业务定义核实。

example.text: 直接连接付款与退款明细或纳入失败付款。
